full_judgment: The appeal arises out of a suit for a declaration that the land in dispute formed part of a Wakf estate of which the appellant Mozaffar Ahmed is the Mutwalli and for khas possession thereof. The lands in dispute belonged to Mokhlesur Rahman who and his three brothers were recorded in the R.S. Khatian as korfa tenants He by a registered deed of Wakf executed on the 4th of Falgoon, 1288 M.E. dedicated the disputed land along with some other lands for the maintenance of a mosque situated at the homestead of Mokhlesur Rahman and for other charitable purposes.
